title: Imperative title of one bounded change
brief:
Stack and folder (e.g. TypeScript, Node 24, folder src/). Read src/feature.ts and src/caller.ts first.
1. In src/feature.ts add `export function name(arg: Type): Result` that ... (exact behaviour, edge cases).
2. In src/feature.test.ts add tests for: ... (cases with expected values).
Done when both checks pass. Do not change any other file; do not rename existing exports.
